capabilities: Anchor selected text or notes to doctrinal context
Query a local DROS backend or direct LLM endpoint
Generate structured doctrinal summaries from chat prompts
Save generated content back into the vault as pavilion notes
Switch output between Chinese and English modes
extras: The manifest carries an 'has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; installation requires manually copying the plugin folder into the vault. The README is bilingual (English and Traditional Chinese), and version 1.0.7 release notes describe strict grounding rules against hallucination and silent mode fallback.
problem: Studying canonical texts in Obsidian lacks grounded retrieval, so readers cannot tie concepts and passages back to exact source spans with structured synthesis.

relations.evidence: query a local DROS backend or direct LLM endpoint

requires.name: API keys for direct or custom LLM endpoints
Local DROS launcher/injector service for backend mode

summary: AI companion that anchors text selections to doctrinal contexts, queries a local DROS backend or LLM, and saves generated summaries as notes.
